_meta.description: The detections stream (logs-dxdfir.detections-*): the logs-*-* base + logs-dxdfir@settings + the YARA/Suricata fields (@detections, incl. Suricata's flattened stats/metadata), the Hayabusa EVTX-detection model (@hayabusa), and the shared @winlog model because Hayabusa projects onto winlog.computer/channel/event_record_id. Priority 500 — higher than the logs-dxdfir.*-* fallback (200) — so this stream composes only this lane's model(s), not every lane's, and bare field names stay contained to the stream that uses them.
